entities.name: Ivan Kožarić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ivan Kožarić was a Croatian artist who worked primarily with sculpture but also in a wide variety of media, including permanent and temporary sculptures, assemblages, proclamations, photographs, paintings, and installations. He lived and worked in Zagreb, Croatia.
